title: A combinatorial framework for clustering graph states: Algorithms and hardness for rank-integrity
summary: We introduce a new notion of distance between two graph states $|G\rangle$ and $|G'\rangle$ on the same set of qubits. This distance is the minimum number of ancilla qubits in a graph state $|\widehat{G}\rangle$ from which both $|G\rangle$ and $|G'\rangle$ can be ``easily prepared''. (When preparing graph states, we are only allowed to use one-qubit Clifford gates, one-qubit Pauli measurements, and classical communication.)
